content.text:
start administrative-file-draft -> 200
poll 1: pls=200 fcs=200 tjob=200 gn=200

observation.command:
cd /workspace
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "start administrative-file-draft -> %{http_code}\n" -X POST "http://localhost:8080/process/start/administrative-file-draft"
# poll readiness of the key services
for i in $(seq 1 15); do
  a=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -m 2 http://localhost:18000/docs 2>/dev/null)
  b=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -m 2 http://localhost:18002/docs 2>/dev/null)
  c=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -m 2 http://localhost:18015/docs 2>/dev/null)
  d=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -m 2 http://localhost:18020/docs 2>/dev/null)
  echo "poll $i: pls=$a fcs=$b tjob=$c gn=$d"
  [ "$a" = "200" ] && [ "$b" = "200" ] && [ "$c" = "200" ] && [ "$d" = "200" ] && break
  sleep 20
done
